title: Selection of Organisations to Operate Active Ageing Centres
what_it_is: Selection of Organisations to Operate Active Ageing Centres

sections.label: AAC provider appointment process
sections.summary: AAC providers are appointed via RFP or direct allocation, and RFPs are open to anyone to apply.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As we expand the AAC network, providers will be appointed via a Request-for-Proposal (RFP) process assessed based on merit, taking into account the proposed operating model, track record and financial viability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To ensure continuity and minimise disruption to seniors, we will also consider directly appointing providers who already have an established local presence and good track record in engaging or serving residents living in the area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In general, demand for social services, including AACs, is expanding quickly and will likely outstrip the capacity of providers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And thank you to the Senior Parliamentary Secretary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I understand the PAP Community Fund has been invited to build and manage AACs in Aljunied Group Representation Constituency (GRC).

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can the Senior Parliamentary Secretary confirm that all AACs including those in Opposition wards will be run on a non-partisan and non-political basis, like ACCs that are run by charitable organisations in Opposition wards today?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: One, is that we will issue RFPs and the other part is direct allocation, depending on whether that particular provider has track record within the space.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: If there is an RFP in that space and there is no direct allocation, then the terms of what is expected is all set out.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: It is open to anyone to apply to be an operator in that space.

sections.label: AAC non-partisan running question
sections.summary: The question asks whether all AACs will be run on a non-political, non-partisan basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: My question is, are all AACs going to be run like how they are run today on a non-political, non-partisan basis?
